mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM ods_user_behavior_diversion oubd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oubd.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_online duoq on (duoq.dates = oubd.dates and duoq.user_id = oubd.user_id and duoq.pkg = dui.pkg and duoq.country = dui.country) WHERE oubd.behavior = 2

SELECT duoq.id, oubd.dates, dui.user_id, dui.last_version, dui.pkg, dui.country, oubd.value, IFNULL(duoq.create_time, now()) FROM ods_user_behavior_diversion oubd INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (oubd.user_id = dui.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_online duoq on (duoq.dates = oubd.dates and duoq.user_id = oubd.user_id and duoq.pkg = dui.pkg and duoq.country = dui.country) WHERE oubd.behavior = 2 and oubd.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}
